# NON-DISCLOSURE AGREEMENT **Effective Date:** [date|req|signer1] **Between:** {{signerName1}} ({{signerEmail1}}) and the Receiving Party --- ## 1. PURPOSE The parties wish to explore a business opportunity and may disclose confidential information that must be protected against unauthorized disclosure. ## 2. CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION "Confidential Information" means any information disclosed by either party, including business plans, technical data, trade secrets, customer lists, and any information designated as "Confidential". ## 3. OBLIGATIONS The Receiving Party agrees to hold all Confidential Information in strict confidence, not disclose it to third parties without prior written consent, and use it solely for evaluating the business relationship. ## 4. ACKNOWLEDGMENT I acknowledge that I have read and understand this Agreement: [check|req|signer1] Initial here: [initial|req|signer1]
# NON-DISCLOSURE AGREEMENT (Page 2) ## 5. EXCLUSIONS Obligations do not apply to information that was publicly available, rightfully possessed prior to disclosure, or independently developed. ## 6. TERM This Agreement continues for three (3) years. Confidentiality obligations survive for five (5) years from last disclosure. ## 7. GOVERNING LAW Governed by the laws of England and Wales. --- ## SIGNATURE **Signature:** [sig|req|signer1] **Name:** {{signerName1}} **Date:** [date|req|signer1]
